title: Reproducible Medical Research with R: Sample Size
summary: A source-mapped BioLang port of the opening two-arm A1c sample-size and constrained-power example.

source.title: Reproducible Medical Research with R - Sample Size Calculations with pwr
source.note: The A1c study example and published pwr inputs are translated to BioLang. The source-reported attrition result of 45 per arm and 90 total is reproduced exactly, with its internal arithmetic inconsistency disclosed rather than corrected.
